We need answer Chinese probability multiple choice. Need solve: (X,Y) uniform in unit disk D: x^2+y^2<1. Determine X and Y independent? same distribution?

Uniform on disk symmetric about origin. Marginal densities f_X(x) = length vertical chord / area = 2 sqrt(1-x^2)/pi for |x|<1, else 0. f_Y(y)=2 sqrt(1-y^2)/pi for |y|<1, else 0. Thus same distribution. Not independent because support not rectangle; e.g. P(X^2+Y^2<1)=1, but if independent with those marginals? Also f_X f_Y not constant on disk. Or P(|X|>sqrt3/2, |Y|>sqrt3/2) positive under independent product, but in disk zero? Actually if |x|>√3/2 and |y|>√3/2 then x^2+y^2>3/4+3/4=1.5 impossible, so joint prob 0; marginal each positive, product positive. Hence not independent. So C: 不独立同分布的随机变量.
Need final line exactly 答案：C.

content:
由于 \((X,Y)\) 在单位圆内均匀分布，其联合密度为

\[
f(x,y)=
\begin{cases}
\frac{1}{\pi}, & x^2+y^2<1\\
0, & \text{其他}
\end{cases}
\]

由对称性可知 \(X\) 和 \(Y\) 的边缘分布相同，因此它们是同分布的。

但 \(X\) 和 \(Y\) 不独立，因为支撑区域不是矩形区域，且例如

\[
P\left(|X|>\frac{\sqrt3}{2}, |Y|>\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)=0
\]

而

\[
P\left(|X|>\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)P\left(|Y|>\frac{\sqrt3}{2}\right)>0
\]

所以不独立。

因此答案是“不独立同分布的随机变量”。

答案：C
